author: Claude Design (design lead)
summary: Storyboard v3: Claude Code's merged v5 (owner direction through 19:30 ET, the food-pantry example, the title) aligned with master prompt v6 (the four-band /requests/:id page, v6 frame and pacing, website-first, the 45 s judge path and the 90 s technical cut). Every shot names its screen id, URL, anchor and take ids.
decisions: Example: one real public example request (owner approved up to 3), the food pantry's weekly sign-up sheet clean-up (Claude Code D1). REQ-INTAKE-07 stays the judges' finished example and the film's fallback only if the real run is not finished by Nov 3, 12:00 PM ET.
The request page is recorded in the nonprofit's own view: the tab that sent the request keeps its request code in memory. The code is never filmed and never goes in a URL (Tessera's access contract).
S06 adds the sort-and-split beat (#step-split). To make room, S10 drops 'It does the busywork, and a person makes every decision about a person.' (keep it if the measured voice leaves time).
No partner claims in the 3:00 or 0:60. Partner beats exist only in the 90 s cut, gated on live receipts.
No act cards; title S00 2.8 s; end card with live screenshots in the door tiles.

Owner, Nov 1: 1-3 dedicated Eranos workers pick up tasks when no volunteer is free. Lines that say 'a volunteer's AI' are gated on the claim's worker kind, with honest fallbacks; the page labels every worker as a volunteer or as one of Eranos's own.
Owner, Nov 1: categorized feeds (PII projects on GitHub, new OCR LLM tools, ...) run, ranked and served by dedicated cloud workers. S15b shows them, gated on real scheduled runs.

click_paths.label: Judge quick tour (45 s, no video)

steps.do: Read the first screen; click 'Try the nonprofit journey on Eranos →'.
The form is filled with the intake example. Either 'Send it (real, public)', which opens your own request page, shows its request code once, and waits honestly, or 'Skip: watch a finished request →'.
steps.honesty: A judge's request is never shown as REQ-INTAKE-07.

steps.do: The finished example replays its four bands at reading speed (Show all skips ahead). Toggle 'Show technical details' to see leases, the 409 refusal and receipts. Click 'Open it →'.
The task object page: what it does, try it, run it; the step map 'Agent drafts' vs 'Person only'; receipts. Click 'Test the queue live in Agora Studio →'.
Run 'NGO auto-pickup' or 'Trigger 409 lease conflict' and read the real JSON. If the demo limit is hit, the card counts down to the retry time.

click_paths.strip: Opt-in strip under the header on both sites when ?tour=judge is present: '45 s tour · 1 Agora · 2 Ask · 3 Watch · 4 The result · 5 Live queue' with the current step highlighted and a close button.

take_id_note: NF01–NF09 and NA01–NA05 are Claude Code's Phase-2 take prefixes (storyboard v5 expected_final_take_ids). NA06-feeds and NX01–NX05 are new.
limits: Times are estimates from the fitted voice model. After voicing, re-time captions to measured speech onsets and re-run the checks.
